name: Solstice USX
oneLiner: USX is Solstice's Solana dollar, backed by audited cash, tokenized Treasuries, and delta-neutral hedged positions with Accountable solvency proofs.
collateral: Diversified reserve of audited cash, tokenized Treasuries, and delta-neutral hedged positions; Solstice publishes aggregate collateralization but not current category weights
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized institutional issuance with multi-oracle pricing and PDA-controlled minting; Accountable publishes aggregate reserve-versus-supply solvency proofs, while secondary access remains available through Solana DeFi markets

latestReport.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (lockstep alignment: snapshot dates pinned to the dated observation the composition review itself records) - Solstice attestation API observed at the 2026-07-28 review

sources.label: Solstice USX product and proof-of-solvency disclosure

oracleRisk.summary: USX minting and redemption validate collateral value through Solstice's proprietary oracle (off-chain aggregation from multiple CEX and DEX sources, stored in on-chain PDAs) cross-referenced against Pyth within a defined tolerance, with stablecoin-peg bounds, staleness detection, and automatic halting on validation failure. There is no borrower-CDP or forced-liquidation branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: USX is minted and redeemed only by KYC'd institutional partners depositing USDC, USDG, or USDT and redeeming primarily for USDG, with no spread and no borrower-owned collateral positions. The Solstice Oracle validates collateral value at the permissioned mint/redeem step (price agreement with Pyth, USDC/USDT peg bounds, staleness halts), and the delta-neutral hedge book is managed by Solstice at the entity level rather than through user positions with collateral-ratio thresholds, liquidation auctions, or shutdown branches, so the V9 collateral-liquidation branch families do not apply.

The authority account is owned by the Solstice USX program, so the program can directly freeze individual USX token accounts and thereby restrict their transfers.

review.evidence: At Solana slot 425778559: mint authority Ze3CQhTMi6KMU3nWZQUegA2JpeFd2eMx1Y2Gswqnto4 (program-owned account) confirmed as direct-minter; program upgrade authority BzMuMbtah9bqN4HERkPo2PsVoaQKD2xfvYq1xfDCFwEb confirmed as funded EOA (owner: System Program, not executable, 8M lamports). All mint-capable controls are issuer-operated EOA/program-owned — consistent with centralized-dependent permissioned-minter model.

notices.title: Retail redemption gap and thin-liquidity depeg
notices.message: USX traded as low as roughly $0.10 on Orca during a December 2025 thin-liquidity event. Solstice documents institutional/KYC redemption, so retail holders without direct redemption access depend on secondary-market liquidity during stress.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Solstice defines USX as its base synthetic dollar and makes delta-neutral hedged digital-asset positions part of the backing alongside cash and tokenized Treasuries. Because the dollar mechanism depends on a managed long-asset and short-derivative book rather than solely on a par fiat claim, synthetic-delta-neutral is the closest closed-taxonomy archetype.
